# SK0215 — The static-member qualifier is not arranged

<!-- Generated from Rules/Rikarin.Skala.Rules.Metadata/rules.json. Do not edit. -->

`skala arrange` would add, remove or change a static-member type qualifier.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | Formatting |
| Default severity | suggestion |
| Scope | Semantic |
| Needs a compilation | yes |
| Fix | no |
| Language version floor | — |
| Since | 2.0 |

## Why

A qualifier can be removed or replaced only if the resulting reference resolves to the same static member. The rule binds both forms and the pipeline rejects any symbol change.

## Example

Instead of:

```csharp
Helpers.Create()
```

Write:

```csharp
Create()
```

## When it does not fire

Ambiguous references and any rewrite that resolves to a different symbol are reverted.

## Configuration

- `resharper_csharp_static_members_qualify_members`
- `resharper_csharp_static_members_qualify_with`
